collage-maker.quickAnswer: Upload 2 to 4 photos and pick a layout: side-by-side, 3 columns, 2x2 grid, or feature-plus-two. Each photo fills its cell with center-crop cover scaling, so a 1600 x 1200 photo in a 594 x 594 cell is cropped to the middle square and drawn edge to edge. Set the gap and background color, then download the 1200 x 1200 PNG.
keyFacts: Four layouts: 2 side-by-side, 3-column grid, 2x2 grid, and 1 large + 2 stacked.
Every cell uses cover scaling — the photo fills the cell completely, cropped from the center.
Gap from 0 to 60 px separates cells; 0 gives a seamless mosaic.
Background color shows through the gaps and fills empty cells.
Empty cells (fewer photos than slots) stay clean instead of breaking the layout.
Output is a square 1200 x 1200 PNG, ready for social posts.
howTo: Pick the layout that fits your photo count.
Drag the gap slider and choose a background color.
Check the live preview — cells fill automatically.
Click Download to save the collage as PNG.
collage-maker.formula:
Canvas: 1200 x 1200. Gap g.
2x2 grid: cell = (1200 - g) / 2.
3 columns: cell width = (1200 - 2g) / 3, height = 1200.
Cover scale per photo: scale = max(cellW / photoW, cellH / photoH).
Example: g = 12 in 2x2 -> cell = 594 px.
collage-maker.workedExample:
2x2 grid, gap 12, photos 1600 x 1200:
1. Cell size: (1200 - 12) / 2 = 594 px square.
2. Cover scale: max(594/1600, 594/1200) = max(0.371, 0.495) = 0.495.
3. Scaled photo: 792 x 594 — the middle 594 x 594 is drawn, 99 px cropped from each side.
4. Four cells plus 12 px gaps = one seamless 1200 x 1200 collage.
benefits: Before/after and event roundups in one shareable image.
Cover scaling means no manual cropping — every cell just works.
Gap and background controls give a designed, not accidental, look.
Square 1200 px output is ideal for Instagram and WhatsApp.
Private collages: family photos never leave your device.
limitations: Max 4 photos and 4 fixed layouts — no freeform arrangements.
Cover cropping may cut faces near photo edges; pre-crop those photos first.
Photo order follows upload order; it cannot be rearranged inside the tool.
Output is always square 1200 x 1200 — no custom canvas sizes.
collage-maker.privacyNote: This tool runs 100% in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.

faqs.q: How many photos can I put in a collage?
faqs.a: 2 to 4. The layouts are designed around those counts: side-by-side for 2, columns for 3, and the 2x2 grid or feature layout for 4. Upload fewer than the slots and the extra cells stay a clean background color.

Never. Every cell uses cover scaling, which fills the cell while keeping the aspect ratio — the overflow is cropped from the edges, centered. Faces near edges can get cropped, so pre-crop tight portraits first.

faqs.q: Can I change the order of photos?
faqs.a: Photos fill cells in upload order. To reorder, clear the photos and re-upload them in the order you want — first uploaded goes to the top-left cell.
1200 x 1200 px PNG — sharp for social posts and prints up to about 4 inches square. The square format fits Instagram posts and WhatsApp sharing perfectly.
Yes — set the gap slider to 0 and the cells tile edge to edge for a seamless mosaic look.

faqs.q: Are my photos uploaded to a server?
faqs.a: No. The collage is composited on a canvas in your browser. Your photos never leave your device.
